items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: Well, do you know Percy Humphrey?

ctx.x: That was later. I guess I heard them again when I came down here to graduate. That's when I heard them. That could be. He was playing at a place on Bourbon Street that was competing Dixieland Hall or something. Yeah. It was kind of another version of Preservation Hall, and I remember hearing them. But, you know, no, I can't. I remember hearing the Eureka on the streets a lot, but who played with them? Tell me some names.
Well, do you know Percy Humphrey?
